# Semlink 2.3.0

A conversation-care release: answers can now be translated in place, questions can be edited and managed without leaving the chat, and long conversations get proper navigation. The embedded settings screens tighten their layout, and the debug MCP gains a production-grade screen recorder.

## 🌐 Translate answers in place

- A translate button sits on every answer — pick a target language from the menu
- While translating, the original text stays visible with a small spinner on each paragraph; the finished translation replaces the answer in place (no popup)
- The chosen language is remembered per answer: reopening the conversation shows the translated text, and "Original" in the menu restores it

## ✏️ Edit and manage your questions

- Hovering a question reveals copy / edit / delete actions (always visible, no gray boxes)
- Edit reopens the question as an in-place white input card with Cancel / Send — sending replaces the old exchange entirely, so history never shows duplicates
- Only the most recent question can be edited; deleting the only exchange in a conversation removes the whole conversation; every delete asks for confirmation

## 🧭 Reading and navigation polish

- Long conversations get a floating scroll-to-bottom button when you scroll away from the newest messages
- The home screen now uses the same spacing rhythm as the onboarding screen
- Text selection uses the accent color instead of a white-on-white highlight
- The community invite link in the onboarding hub points to the new Discord server

## ⚙️ Settings, aligned

- Every settings tab now uses the Model tab's full-width layout — the segmented tab bar and the content cards share the same edges on Base, Model, Vault, Tools and Share
- The ✨ upgrade badge no longer appears once a license is active
- The status bar shows just the note count

## 💾 Storage housekeeping

- The one-time pre-migration database backup (typically ~400 MB) is now deleted automatically once the migration has been healthy for 3 days; deletion is guarded by the live-slot integrity check, and the age is read from the file's real modification time

## 🧰 Developer tooling (semlink-debug MCP)

- Recording rebuilt on WebCodecs VP9 (MediaRecorder silently produced empty files): the real mouse pointer is drawn onto every frame with a flight animation and click ripples, capture survives window occlusion (background throttling disabled + worker-driven heartbeat), and `bitrate` / `zoom` / window targeting are parameters — `status` reports `actualFps` so throttling is visible at a glance
- New `session` tool (list / new / home / delete) resets or cleans demo conversations; `ui` gained scroll, hover, keyboard injection and hidden-element queries; `chatview` exposes the answer's citation registry; `measure` can resize the sidebar and clamps it when the window shrinks

## 🌍 i18n

- 11 new UI strings translated across all 10 language packs (zh, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, it, ru)

**Download**: main.js, manifest.json and styles.css are attached to this release. Updating from inside Obsidian picks up all three automatically.
